title: scheme-extraction logic duplicated in require_http_url and validate_session_urls
description: client.rs:607-615 and client.rs:636-645: both functions contain the identical pattern: url.find("://").map(|i| &url[..i]).unwrap_or("").to_ascii_lowercase(). Extract to a single pub(crate) fn extract_url_scheme(url: &str) -> String helper to remove the duplication and centralize the RFC 3986 §3.1 case-insensitivity logic.
